content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 182.0732, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.0659 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely is C₆H₁₃O₆ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 181.0712 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). No other common heteroatoms are indicated by the isotopic pattern, so the simplest formula is C₆H₁₃O₆.
